title: 准备跨方向面试：怎么把真实经历讲清楚｜中英双语
excerpt: 这两天和 Codex 来回磨简历、自我介绍和面试问答。我想要的是把真实经历讲成岗位能用的能力，不是背一串技术名。把中英文准备稿和几个能复用的表达方法一起留在这里。

blocks.text: 这两天在准备一个创投实习的申请和面试。我的经历主要是医疗 AI，怎么把技术项目讲成这个岗位真正关心的能力，是这次和 Codex 来回打磨的重点。简历、自我介绍、问答都整理了一遍，中英文一起留在这里，算一份自己的准备笔记。

I’ve been preparing an application and interview for a venture capital internship. Most of my experience is in healthcare AI, so the work with Codex has centred on explaining how that experience is relevant to the role. These are my bilingual preparation notes, covering the CV, introduction and interview answers.
我一开始就提了两个要求：经历必须真实；回答要突出我解决过什么问题、怎么解决、能带来什么价值。不要最后变成一串项目名和技术名，也不想逐题背答案。

My starting requirements were simple: keep the experience accurate, and explain the problems I’ve solved, my contribution and the value I could bring. I wanted something more useful than a list of projects and tools, and more flexible than memorised answers.

blocks.label: 阅读说明 / A note on scope
blocks.text: 这是申请与面试准备分享，不是面试复盘。以下问题是根据一份具体 JD 推演的准备方向，回答是参考稿；公开版省去了公司名称、内部指标、邮件及个人申请安排。/ These are preparation notes, not an account of what happened in the interview. The questions are inferred from one job description. The answers are practice drafts, with company names, internal metrics, correspondence and personal logistics omitted.
先看岗位，再决定讲什么 / Start with the role
这份 JD 包括行业与公司研究、竞争比较和尽调支持，也包括基金设立、募资材料、会议记录、投后项目跟踪和内外部协调。它还要求中英文沟通，重视商业合作或 BD 经历。因此，准备时只讲 AI 技术，覆盖不了整个岗位。

The job description covered industry and company research, competitive comparisons and due diligence support, alongside fund setup, fundraising materials, meeting notes, portfolio project tracking and coordination. It also called for Chinese–English communication and valued commercial or BD experience. A purely technical introduction would leave much of the role unaddressed.
讨论中有一句“面试官最可能关注分析问题、理解科技项目、推进任务、讲清结论”，我又追问了一句：为什么这样说？这里需要留住一个边界：这是从职责做出的准备判断，并不是公司公布的面试评分表。而且它偏向了我已有的优势，不能代替对募资、沟通和日常支持工作的准备。

I asked why we expected the interview to focus on analysis, understanding technology projects, execution and clear communication. The distinction matters: those were preparation hypotheses drawn from the responsibilities, not a published interview rubric. They also favoured my existing strengths, so they couldn’t replace preparation for fundraising support, coordination and routine administrative work.

items: 研究与尽调支持 → 找信息、比证据、区分事实与判断。 / Research and diligence support → gather information, compare evidence, distinguish facts from interpretation.
项目计划与跟踪 → 拆解任务、记录依赖和状态、及时反馈阻碍。 / Project planning and tracking → define tasks, track dependencies and progress, surface blockers.
材料与沟通 → 先说业务意义，再说依据和下一步。 / Materials and communication → explain the business implication, evidence and next step.
技术背景 → 为科技项目提供具体问题和判断依据；同时补上商业与投资知识。 / Technical experience → contribute informed questions about products while developing commercial and investment knowledge.

blocks.text: 定制简历：改表达，保留事实 / Tailoring without changing the facts
这次定制时，我要求在事实不变的前提下重新组织重点，原版简历完整保留。技术型号和训练算法可以少写一点，把业务问题、自己的贡献和验证方法说清楚。岗位需要的是哪种能力，就选能证明它的真实材料。

For this version, I asked to reorganise the emphasis while preserving the facts and keeping the original CV intact. Some model names and training details could be shortened to make room for the business problem, my contribution and how results were evaluated. The evidence should be chosen to demonstrate the capabilities the role needs.
几个不能越过去的地方：医疗销售模型不等于我做过 BD；内部模型评测不等于投资尽调；随访系统里的任务状态管理不等于管理投资组合。可以解释能力如何迁移，但职位、职责和结果的口径不能跟着 JD 一起变。

A few boundaries stayed explicit: working on a healthcare sales model is not personal BD experience; internal model evaluation is not investment due diligence; task tracking within a care application is not portfolio management. I can explain how the skills transfer without changing the role I held or the meaning of the results.
我给的参考框架是：20% 讲我是谁，70% 用案例讲为什么是我，10% 讲我为什么来。最开始的版本我觉得还不够好，就继续拿具体参考让它重写。这里整理成能接着说的一版；比例用于分配重点，不必卡秒。中英文长度和语速不同，还是要自己读一遍。

The structure I brought into the discussion was 20% on who I am, 70% on evidence of fit, and 10% on why I’m applying. I wasn’t satisfied with the early version and asked for a rewrite using more specific examples. Here is a connected practice draft. The percentages guide emphasis; they aren’t a stopwatch rule. Each language needs its own read-through.

第一部分｜行业领域 + 核心职能 + 独特优势
面试官您好，我叫卢佳栋，目前在新加坡国立大学读硕士。过去的工作和实习主要围绕医疗健康领域的 AI 应用，核心是把业务需求转化为可上线的产品，并通过数据分析持续改善效果。我比较擅长结合技术实现和真实用户反馈，分析一个 AI 产品能解决什么问题、落地的难点在哪里，以及如何验证实际效果。

Part 1 | Background, role and distinctive strength
Hello, my name is Jiadong Lu, and I’m currently pursuing a master’s degree at the National University of Singapore. My work and internship experience has focused on healthcare AI: translating business needs into working products and using data to improve performance. My strength is combining technical understanding with real user feedback to assess what a product can solve, the challenges it faces in practice, and how to evaluate its effectiveness.

第二部分｜困难 + 行动 + 结果
举一个具体例子。我参与过一个帮助医疗机构获取销售线索的对话模型项目。难点是模型在真实用户对话中，仍会出现不符合业务要求的回答。我先分析线上对话，梳理失败模式和原因，再针对性修复训练数据、迭代模型，并结合评测和用户对话仿真检查改进效果。上线后发现的问题，也会进入下一轮优化。经过持续迭代，真实对话评测中的问题回答比例下降了。这段经历让我积累了从实际使用中发现问题、用数据定位原因、再验证改进的方法，也可以用于科技项目的研究和跟踪。

Part 2 | Challenge, action and outcome
One example is a conversational AI project that helped healthcare providers capture sales leads. Some responses still failed to meet business requirements in real conversations. I reviewed production conversations to identify failure patterns and their causes, then improved the training examples and model. I used evaluations and simulated conversations to check the changes, and fed new issues from production into later iterations. The failure rate in our real-conversation evaluations decreased. This gave me a practical approach to identifying problems, investigating causes and validating improvements—an approach I could bring to researching and tracking technology projects.

第三部分｜能力匹配 + 动机 + 礼貌收尾
我希望把这些经验用于科技项目研究和投后项目支持，同时学习如何从商业和投资角度判断项目价值。期待有机会加入团队，谢谢。

Part 3 | Contribution and motivation
I’d like to bring that experience to technology research and portfolio project support, while learning how to assess businesses from a commercial and investment perspective. Thank you for the opportunity to introduce myself.
这里留意两件事：结果要有具体口径；动机要是自己真的愿意说的话。公开分享省去了内部数字，实际面试中也只使用可以披露、能解释清楚的证据。滚动更新的评测集不能说成固定对照实验，问题回答比例也不能改叫成交转化率。

Two details matter in this draft: explain what the outcome actually measures, and use a motivation you can honestly stand behind. Internal figures are omitted here; in an interview, use only evidence you can disclose and explain. A rolling evaluation is not a fixed controlled experiment, and response failures are not sales conversion rates.
少背题，多准备几个能展开的答案 / A small set of reusable answers
下面六类问题是准备方向，不是这家公司一定会问的题。每个答案都围绕能力、行动和岗位价值，技术细节留给追问。

These six questions are preparation prompts, not predictions of the company’s exact interview. Each answer focuses on capability, action and relevance to the role, with technical detail reserved for follow-up questions.

1｜为什么从技术申请创投？
我希望把对技术产品的理解延伸到商业价值判断。过去做医疗 AI 时，我需要理解业务需求、分析真实效果并改进产品。这让我能在研究科技项目时提出具体问题：产品解决什么需求、效果有什么证据、落地有什么限制。我希望先从研究和项目跟踪贡献这些能力，同时学习投资分析。

1 | Why venture capital after a technical role?
I’d like to extend my understanding of technology products to how businesses create value. In healthcare AI, I’ve worked on business needs, real-world performance and product improvement. That gives me a practical starting point for research: what need does the product address, what evidence supports it, and what limits adoption? I’d contribute that perspective while developing my investment analysis skills.

2｜你如何用数据解决问题？
在医疗对话模型项目中，我先分析真实对话中的失败模式，再针对原因修复训练数据、迭代模型，最后通过评测跟踪变化。我的贡献是把发现问题、修复问题和验证效果连接起来。用于项目研究时，我也会先找证据，再形成判断，并保留结论的适用范围。

2 | How have you used data to solve a problem?
In the healthcare dialogue project, I investigated failures in real conversations, used those findings to improve training data and the model, and tracked the changes through evaluation. My contribution connected diagnosis, corrective action and validation. I’d use the same discipline in research: gather evidence, form a judgment, and make its limitations clear.

3｜有什么经验可以迁移到项目支持？
在慢病随访助手项目中，我设计了把长期管理计划拆成定时任务的日历，记录执行动作、状态和结果。它是产品中的任务管理机制，但锻炼了我拆解复杂需求、让执行可跟踪的能力。用于项目支持时，我会明确任务、依赖和进度，及时反馈影响交付的问题。

3 | What experience would help with project support?
For a chronic-care assistant, I designed a calendar that translated long-term care plans into scheduled actions with tracked status and recorded outcomes. This was a product feature, but it developed my ability to break down complex requirements and make execution trackable. I’d apply that discipline to tasks, dependencies, progress and delivery risks.

4｜你会怎样研究一家 AI 公司？
我会先确认研究需要支持什么判断，再看客户需求、产品证据和落地条件。谁在使用、为什么需要它，效果来自测试还是真实客户，部署有什么要求？然后交叉核对公司材料、公开信息和同类产品，把已确认事实、我的判断和待验证问题分开整理。

4 | How would you research an AI company?
I’d clarify the decision the research needs to support, then examine the customer need, product evidence and requirements for adoption. Who uses it, why do they need it, and do the performance claims come from testing or customers? I’d cross-check company materials with public information and comparable products, separating verified facts, interpretation and open questions.

5｜如何向非技术同事表达？
我会先说业务意义，再解释证据。介绍医疗对话模型时，先讲它服务什么需求、哪些回答不符合要求、效果怎么衡量，技术细节按需要展开。如果用于投资团队，我会把结果整理成：目前知道什么、还不确定什么、下一步要验证什么。

5 | How would you communicate with a non-technical team?
I’d start with the business implication and then explain the evidence. For the dialogue model, that means the need it serves, the responses that failed requirements and how performance was measured. I’d add technical detail where useful. For an investment team, I’d make clear what we know, what remains uncertain and what to verify next.

6｜没有基金或 IR 经验，怎么上手？
这些是我需要学习的部分。我目前能贡献的是技术理解、数据分析和执行能力。接到陌生任务时，我会先确认用途、受众、截止时间和审核要求，再参考已有模板准备初稿，把不确定信息标出来及时核实。基金和募资材料尤其需要事实准确、数据口径一致、版本清楚。

6 | How would you contribute without fund or IR experience?
Those would be new areas for me. My immediate strengths are understanding technology, analysing evidence and following through on work. For an unfamiliar assignment, I’d clarify its purpose, audience, deadline and review requirements, then use existing examples to prepare a draft. I’d flag uncertainties early and check them with the task owner, paying attention to accuracy, consistent figures and version control.
最后记住一条线 / The framework I’m keeping
我这次想要的，就是基于少量关键点灵活回答，而不是多背一份题库。准备材料可以收在两个案例里：医疗对话模型用来讲分析与验证；慢病随访助手用来讲需求拆解与执行。问题变了，就调整开头的能力结论和结尾的岗位价值，中间事实保持不变。

The goal for this preparation was to answer flexibly from a few key points rather than memorise a question bank. Two examples carry most of the evidence: the dialogue model for analysis and validation, and the care assistant for requirements and execution. Change the opening emphasis and the link to the role; keep the underlying facts consistent.

blocks.label: 回答顺序 / Answer structure
blocks.text:
能力结论 → 一个困难 → 我的关键行动 → 结果与边界 → 对岗位的价值
Strength → Challenge → My contribution → Outcome and limitations → Relevance to the role
中文提示句：我比较有把握的是……。例如在……中，我们遇到……，我主要做了……，最终……。这段经验能帮助我在这个岗位上……。
English prompt: One strength I’d bring is ___. In one project, we faced ___. My contribution was to ___. The result was ___. I’d apply that experience to ___ in this role.
做过的事情用“我做了”；陌生职责的工作思路用“我会”。遇到追问再展开，别在开场把所有技术细节都塞完。先把这几个点练顺。

Use “I did” for actual experience and “I would” for a proposed approach to new responsibilities. Leave room for follow-up questions instead of packing every technical detail into the opening. These are the points to practise first.
